metadata.case_name: TSANG HING CHEUNG v. CHAN PO LING STELLA AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_after: light-duty electrician; wall-painter; light electrical worker; employed by MTR; worked at science park

injuries.description: Injury to the plaintiff's dominant/right hand
source: the injury to the plaintiff was to his the dominant hand

The plaintiff's right hand achieved with lifting force of 19 kg, carrying force of 19 kg, pushing force of 85 kg and pulling force of 80 kg at the final physical and work tolerance evaluation on 26 November 2000.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified

manifestations.description: Reduced lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling force in right hand: lifting 19 kg, carrying 19 kg, pushing 85 kg, pulling 80 kg (final physical and work tolerance evaluation on 26 November 2000).

treatments_received: Final physical and work tolerance evaluation on 26 November 2000

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities assessed at $250,000.
